name: css-variables-generator
description: CSS custom properties generator from JSON tokens

scripts.build:shared: npm run assert:repo-root && npm -w @flujo/shared run build
scripts.ci:preflight: npm run assert:repo-root && npm run assert:shared-manifest-convention && npm run assert:tsx-runtime && npm run build:shared
scripts.generate: npm run assert:repo-root && npm run assert:tsx-runtime && tsx tooling/src/cli/index.ts
scripts.generate:registry: npm run assert:repo-root && npm run assert:tsx-runtime && tsx tooling/src/cli/index.ts --registry
scripts.generate:strict: npm run assert:repo-root && npm run assert:tsx-runtime && tsx tooling/src/cli/index.ts --mode-strict
scripts.validate:docs: npm run assert:repo-root && npm run assert:tsx-runtime && tsx tooling/src/runners/validate-docs-runner.ts
scripts.ds:tokens-from-figma: npm run assert:repo-root && npm run assert:tsx-runtime && tsx tooling/src/runners/tokens-from-figma-runner.ts
scripts.ds:token-health: npm run generate:registry && npm run ds:token-usage-index && npm run ds:token-graph && node tooling/scripts/ds-token-health.mjs
scripts.ds:health:record: npm run ds:token-health && npm run ds:registry:report && npm run ds:health-snapshot
scripts.ds:figma-component-map: npm run assert:repo-root && npm run assert:tsx-runtime && tsx tooling/src/runners/figma-component-map-runner.ts
scripts.ds:spec-from-figma: npm run assert:repo-root && npm run assert:tsx-runtime && tsx tooling/src/runners/spec-from-figma-runner.ts
scripts.test:tooling: npm run assert:repo-root && npm run build:shared && npm run test:tooling:ds-types && npm run test:tooling:core
scripts.test:server: npm run test:server:node && npm run test:server:tsx
scripts.test:plugin:bridge: npm run assert:repo-root && npm run build:shared && npm --prefix apps/figma-plugin run test:bridge
scripts.typecheck:plugin: npm run assert:repo-root && npm run build:shared && npm --prefix apps/figma-plugin run typecheck
scripts.test:changed-surface: npm run test:plugin:bridge && npm run test:dashboard:routes
